daily.title: NT sex offenders to be banned from using character references under draft laws
daily.summary: A new bill set to be introduced to NT parliament this week would remove convicted sex offenders' ability to use good character references during sentencing, and allow those accused to be identified from their first court appearance.

daily.title: Volunteer hospitalised after Brisbane City councillor's dog bites hand

daily.title: Thirty years on from Diana's iconic work, landmine production is up
